definition: Lingoes is a dictionary and machine translation app.
details: Lingoes was created in China. Lingoes is often compared to its competitor Babylon because of similarities in their GUI, functionalities and most importantly being freeware.

explainer.lead: Lingoes is a dictionary and machine translation app created in China. It matters as a freeware alternative often compared to Babylon for its GUI and functionality.

tiers.eli5: It is a free app for looking up words and translating text.
tiers.practitioner: Used as a freeware dictionary and translation tool; a pitfall is expecting parity with machine translation services beyond what a dictionary and translation app provides.
tiers.paperLevel: Defined as a dictionary and machine translation app; often compared to Babylon due to similar GUI, functionalities, and freeware status.

explainer.example: A user looks up a word or translates text in a freeware app whose interface and features resemble Babylon's.
